concepts.quote: With a while loop the output is the same here, because 81 >= 70 is true at the start; it would only differ if i started below 70.
concepts.why: The answer relates do-while to while: they differ only in the omitted first test, so they match whenever the first test is true. This is adapting to a familiar variant, so it is relational, not L4.
The answer correctly evaluates the loop condition with this code's starting value but does not relate it further.
